rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something lacking meaning, significance, or a worthwhile point.

example.english: Those politicians’ slogans are meaningless for improving people’s lives.
example.traditional: 政客講嗰啲口號對改善民生冇意義。
example.jyutping: zing3 haak3 gong2 go2 di1 hau2 hou6 deoi3 goi2 sin6 man4 saang1 mou5 ji3 ji6

rows.note: Use this especially when a word, statement, or sign conveys no meaning; it can also suggest that something is uninteresting.

example.english: This string of symbols is really meaningless to me.
example.traditional: 你寫呢串符號出嚟，對我嚟講真係冇意思。
example.jyutping: nei5 se2 ne1 cyun3 fu4 hou6 ceot1 lai4 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 mou5 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this for efforts or actions that are pointless because they will not help or achieve anything.

example.english: No matter how much you persuade him, he will not change, so continuing to talk is meaningless.
example.traditional: 你再點勸佢都唔會改，繼續講落去都冇用。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 dim2 hyun3 keoi5 dou1 m4 wui5 goi2 gai3 zuk6 gong2 lok6 heoi3 dou1 mou5 jung6
